name: Meeting Notice 10
definition: Information about a meeting, participation requirements and voting procedures.

MeetingIdentification.name: Meeting Identification
MeetingIdentification.definition: Identification assigned to the general meeting by the party that provides the meeting notification. It must be unique to the party providing the notification

IssuerMeetingIdentification.name: Issuer Meeting Identification
IssuerMeetingIdentification.definition: Identification assigned to the meeting by the issuer. It must be unique for the issuer.

OneManOneVoteIndicator.name: One Man One Vote Indicator
OneManOneVoteIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the meeting vote is held under the "one-man-one-vote" principle, also known as "per capita vote" whereby the shareholder attending the meeting has one vote only, regardless of the holding positions.

Participation.name: Participation
Participation.definition: Method of voting participation to the general meeting and related voting deadline per method of participation.

Attendance.name: Attendance
Attendance.definition: Information and conditions for physical attendance at the general meeting.

AdditionalDocumentationURLAddress.name: Additional Documentation URL Address
AdditionalDocumentationURLAddress.definition: Address to use over the www (HTTP) service where additional information on the meeting may be found.

EventProcessingWebSiteAddress.name: Event Processing Web Site Address
EventProcessingWebSiteAddress.definition: Provides web address of an account servicer (or of a service provider) that contains information solely intended for the immediate account holder to enable or facilitate event processing between parties.

AdditionalProcedureDetails.name: Additional Procedure Details
AdditionalProcedureDetails.definition: Additional procedural information about the general meeting, specifying the participation requirements and the voting procedures. Alternatively, this may indicate where such information may be obtained.

TotalNumberOfSecuritiesOutstanding.name: Total Number Of Securities Outstanding
TotalNumberOfSecuritiesOutstanding.definition: Number of securities admitted to the vote, expressed as an amount and a currency.

TotalNumberOfVotingRights.name: Total Number Of Voting Rights
TotalNumberOfVotingRights.definition: Number of rights admitted to the vote.

ProxyAppointmentNotificationAddress.name: Proxy Appointment Notification Address
ProxyAppointmentNotificationAddress.definition: Address where the information on the proxy should be sent.

ProxyChoice.name: Proxy Choice
ProxyChoice.definition: Specifies the proxy or whether a proxy is not allowed.

ContactPersonDetails.name: Contact Person Details
ContactPersonDetails.definition: Contact person at the party organising the meeting, at the issuer or at an intermediary.

ResultPublicationDate.name: Result Publication Date
ResultPublicationDate.definition: Date on which the company publishes the results of its meeting.

SecuritiesBlockingPeriodEndDate.name: Securities Blocking Period End Date
SecuritiesBlockingPeriodEndDate.definition: Date by which the blocking period for the securities should end.

EntitlementFixingDate.name: Entitlement Fixing Date
EntitlementFixingDate.definition: Date at which the positions are struck to record which parties will receive the entitlement, for example, record date, book close date.

RegistrationSecuritiesDeadline.name: Registration Securities Deadline
RegistrationSecuritiesDeadline.definition: Date by which the securities have to be registered. This deadline is specified by an intermediary.

RegistrationSecuritiesMarketDeadline.name: Registration Securities Market Deadline
RegistrationSecuritiesMarketDeadline.definition: Date by which the securities have to be registered. This deadline is set by the issuer.

EnrolmentMarketDeadline.name: Enrolment Market Deadline
EnrolmentMarketDeadline.definition: Date by which enrolment for participation in the general meeting or exercise of voting rights must be instructed. This deadline is set by the issuer.

EnrolmentDeadline.name: Enrolment Deadline
EnrolmentDeadline.definition: Date by which enrolment for participation in the general meeting or exercise of voting rights must be instructed. This deadline is set by the intermediary.
